template: As of {timestamp}, is {area} affected by the reported {event}? Clearly state what is confirmed, name the source, and say when that information was current.
What should someone in {area} do right now because of the reported {event}? Prioritize immediate protective actions and identify the official guidance supporting them.
Which official agency, alert system, or website should someone in {area} check for current instructions about the {event}? Provide specific source names rather than only general advice.
Does the reported {event} mean someone in {area} should evacuate, shelter in place, or wait for local instructions? Explain how to verify which instruction applies to their exact location.
What important facts about the reported {event} in {area} cannot be confirmed from the information currently available? Do not guess; explain what the user should verify and where.
